Overview

About the Spectrum-X Ethernet

NVIDIA Spectrum-X is an end-to-end Ethernet platform built for multi-tenant generative AI factories. Spectrum-X switches and SuperNICs work together to deliver the bandwidth, low latency and performance isolation that AI needs on standards-based Ethernet.

Spectrum-XGS extends the same fabric across data centers, so geographically distributed sites can operate as one large AI factory.

1.6x AI network performance

Compared with off-the-shelf Ethernet for AI workloads.

Massive scale

Two-tier topologies reach hundreds of thousands of GPUs; Multiplane extends to 128,000 GPUs.

Tenant isolation

Telemetry-based congestion control keeps noisy neighbours from slowing other jobs.

Adaptive routing

Switch and SuperNIC coordinate to maximise effective bandwidth and resilience.

Spectrum-XGS

Multi-site NCCL collectives run up to 1.9x faster across data centers.

Co-packaged optics

Up to 5x better power efficiency than transceiver-based networks.
